checklist.evidence: Build template families for the tech stacks found in the inventory.
Run the new CI in shadow on PRs for one week... Only one pipeline may deploy a service at any moment.
Build each image once and promote the same version through every environment.
Cloud access uses short-lived OIDC tokens scoped per repo and environment.
Every image is signed (cosign with a cloud KMS key) and carries an SBOM and build provenance.
expand/contract migrations, run as an Argo pre-sync job
Merge queue and flaky-test quarantine: feedback p90 goes over 10 min because of retries.
Self-hosted, throwaway runners (one job per pod) in an isolated CI account with no route to production
Platform service-level targets with burn-rate alerts.
On-call has an audited break-glass deploy

traps.evidence: Old deploy jobs are disabled, not deleted, until V6 passes.
Registry: managed (ECR or GAR) with immutable tags.
removal of all static CI secrets
Each team gets an Argo AppProject that restricts it to its own namespaces

note: Strong, security-centered, well-sequenced GitOps migration plan with explicit assumptions and validation; weak on contract testing, flaky tests, and quantified compute cost.
